explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our cephalexin supply to a plant last inspected 2024-09-06 and classified VAI

sentences.text: FDA's most recent inspection of that plant ended 2024-09-06 and was classified VAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2024-11-13.
No FDA shortage posting, recall, or OAI classification for this product or plant appears in the provided records.
Corvale East has 5 days on hand (88 units at 17.5/day) and Corvale General has 27 days on hand (399 units at 15.1/day).
Corvale Lakeside holds 6 days on hand (27 units at 4.4/day) and is not positioned to supply a transfer.
Verify current on-hand and daily-use figures at both sites before executing the transfer, and confirm no new FDA actions have been posted since the last inspection date.

Q-5014e4.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%cephalexin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%cephalexin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-d39f2f.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('b6ffe633-dd91-6d49-e053-2a95a90a5ac6') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-7cff28.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%cephalexin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-1df0f2.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%cephalexin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-16c3a2.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%cephalexin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%capsule%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-20b22c.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3017450153') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-37f066.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3017450153') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-12f038.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3017450153') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('advanced rx pharmacy tennessee')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-cf6abf.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('advanced rx pharmacy tennessee') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%cephalexin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-e66ffd.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('80425012101')

Q-4c8313.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%cephalexin%'
